query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_festas,
  MIN(valorTotal)/100 as menor_valor,
  MAX(valorTotal)/100 as maior_valor,
  AVG(valorTotal)/100 as media,
  SUM(CASE WHEN valorTotal < 200000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as festas_abaixo_2k,
  SUM(CASE WHEN valorTotal > 800000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as festas_acima_8k,
  SUM(CASE WHEN valorTotal >= 200000 AND valorTotal <= 800000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as festas_faixa_normal
FROM festas;
